research_brief.central_hypothesis: A hybrid PV-TPV net-efficiency comparison becomes interpretable only through matched source, spectral, thermal, electrical, metrology, uncertainty, and stability boundaries.
research_brief.reference_configuration: single-converter configuration under identical declared source and input boundary
research_brief.intervention: spectral partition into direct-PV and thermal-emitter/TPV paths

measurement_contract.input_boundary: named source card containing spectrum or thermal condition, geometry, aperture, and time window
measurement_contract.comparison_rule: reference and candidate must use the same denominator and calibrated acquisition protocol
